findings.spec: FR-8 and Flow 2 step 4 (one confirmation-only text); Reliability (a retry never sends the same message twice)
findings.summary: sendPendingConfirmations ran the Twilio message-list lookup inside the send try/catch. A lookup failing with 429 or 503 throws TwilioSendError (refused: true); recordSendError then marked the row pending, and a pending row is resent without a lookup, so a confirmation Twilio took during the timed-out webhook attempt is sent a second time.
findings.reproduction: src/optout/optout.test.ts 'a failed Twilio lookup after a timeout never leads to a resend without a lookup' fails on main (row status pending) and passes with the fix.

observations: O-72-1: sentSince treats any text from our number to the customer after the opt-out as the confirmation. A review request claimed just before the opt-out and sent just after it would count, and the confirmation would not be resent (lost, never doubled). Rare; no change.

O-72-2: the lookup compares Twilio date_created with Postgres now() floored to the second; clock skew over 1 s between them could miss the sent text and allow a resend. Hosted clocks are NTP-synced; not reproducible here.

O-59-1: purgeOffboardedBusinesses has no per-business catch although its comment says 'a failure stops only it': one business whose delete throws stops the rest for that run. Every FK under businesses cascades or sets null today (checked in pg_constraint), so no current input triggers it.
